method: Each actual selected1536x1024 photograph was viewed individually at native resolution. Adjacent body silhouette, limb articulation, paw positions and support states were compared visually. SHA values bind observations to selected files; hashes were not used as evidence of pose difference. Coordinate estimates are approximate visual observations.
scope: Early001–009 pose distinction only. No images, guides or other receipts edited during this review. This is not a natural16-frame continuous-run or biomechanical pass.

per_frame.actual_pose: Maximum extended airborne stride: long forelimbs reach left, rear limbs trail almost horizontally right, all paws off ground; widest limb span.
Forefeet lower and shift right toward landing, rear stifles/hocks fold under hips; still airborne, shorter rear reach than001.
One fore sole planted nearx400,y835, other forepaw remains in front/air aroundx175,y780; rear paws staggered and flexed under hips.
Two fore soles flat nearx285/y855 andx415/y860; chest/neck visibly lower, hip high and back pitched/arched; rear feet remain raised and folded.
Chest rises and back is flatter, forelegs stand closer under shoulder with soles aroundy830; rear feet remain airborne and flexed.
One foreleg folds to chest while the remaining long foreleg has sole aroundx470,y870, with slight support shadow; hindfeet recover farther underneath body.
All four paws airborne, both forelegs curl downward under chest, rearlegs fold forward and spine rounds slightly.
Deeper collected aerial pose: forefeet curl backward/right with visible pads, rearfeet tucked higher toward belly, rounded back; four paws separately readable in revised008.

Revised recovery/descending pose: hindfeet lowered about40–60px from008, torso flatter/longer and less deeply gathered, forefeet still curl beneath chest but pads/angles change; all four paws airborne.

result.summary_ko: 새v3의1–9에서는 최대 확장→하강→첫 앞발 접지→두 앞발 지지/가슴 눌림→체중 이동→한 앞발 회수→앞발 이륙→깊은 모으기→뒷발 하강으로 실제 실루엣과 발 배치가 바뀝니다. 같은 포즈의 미세한 반복으로 보이는 인접 쌍은 없었습니다. 자세 차이가 보인다는 판정과 자연스러운 연속 달리기 판정은 구분합니다.
result.summary_en: The new v3 frames001–009 visibly progress through maximum extension, descent, first fore support, double fore support/compression, late support, single fore recovery, fore liftoff, deeper gather and hind descent. No adjacent pair reads as an unchanged or nearly unchanged silhouette. Visible pose distinction does not establish natural continuous running.

camera_and_pose_continuity_limits: Head/neck/body height and apparent proportions vary; pronounced chest/head movement remains across003→004→005.
Virtual support-foot heights change between photographs despite the uniform background; no fixed visible floor/horizon gives strict contact tracking.
Support-paw motion is not uniformly rearward relative to the body, notably005→006; foot trajectories are not measured physical motion.
Fur shape, foreleg white/black coverage, tail outline and paw-pad angles vary between independently generated images.
Guide adherence, exact frame-to-frame velocity and real capture fps are not validated by this distinctness review.
